correctness.rationale: Irreducibility follows from Eisenstein at a simple zero of the Kummer right-hand side; the bidegree (m,n) compactification is smooth in the torus and at every boundary point. The log-Gauss function factors through u=x^m and a degree-two rational h(u). Explicit reciprocal automorphism plus mu_m x mu_n rotations gives 2mn distinct deck transformations, the covering degree, hence a Galois extension. Four valuation sites of the Kummer map and the two simple critical points of h give the complete branch signatures. Riemann–Hurwitz matches exactly. The supplied actual verifier checks symbolic identities, five exact examples, and group permutation relations, but finite tests are not treated as the general proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete, natural, unbounded family of smooth positive-genus toric curves with a *Galois* logarithmic Gauss map, not merely an isolated example or a numerical volume. The generalized-dihedral group and four explicit inertia partitions determine the covering as a regular Hurwitz object and identify all exceptional logarithmic normal directions. This precise structural invariant is nontrivial even though its degree is predicted by Newton area.
